# SK4007 — Review large struct arguments in loops

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A source struct with known field payload exceeding dotnet_code_quality.SK4007.threshold (default 64 bytes) is passed by value in a loop body.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Performance |
| Default severity | hint |
| Scope | Semantic |
| Needs a compilation | yes |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 1.3 |

## Why

Repeated by-value calls can copy a substantial struct. This rule uses a target-independent lower bound from primitive fields and same-file nested structs, not an ABI layout guess or Marshal.SizeOf. A by-reference API may reduce copying but can change aliasing, mutation and overload behavior, so the rule is report-only.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
// Large has nine long fields: at least 72 bytes.
foreach (var item in items) { Consume(large); } // Consume(Large value)
```

Write:

```csharp
// Measure and consider a reviewed in/ref API, or retain the by-value snapshot intentionally.
```

## When it does not fire

Only explicit identity-converted local/parameter arguments to by-value struct parameters in for/foreach/while/do bodies are supported. The threshold is strictly exceeded; invalid, zero or negative values fall back to 64. Size counts primitive field payload, including decimal and compiler backing fields, and recursively known same-file non-generic non-partial structs. Explicit/auto layout, other-file and metadata structs, generic structs, references, native integers, pointers, fixed buffers, ref fields and unknown fields contribute zero rather than an invented size. Layout attributes depending on another source file's constants are excluded. Padding and StructLayout.Size are ignored. in/ref/out arguments, factories, conversions, nested callable bodies and constructor calls are excluded. JIT copy elision and intentional value isolation require review. skala.size.lower_bound records the proven payload bound.

## Configuration

- `dotnet_code_quality.SK4007.threshold`
- `dotnet_diagnostic.SK4007.severity`
